name: identical-large-output-becomes-duplicate-note
description: Two different calls that print the same large output: the second result is replaced by a duplicate note that points to a stored copy. The stored copy lives in a directory the extension names pi-warden-output-<random>: the original randomizes that name on every run (Node mkdtemp), so the scenario's own normalize rule masks it.

arguments.command: i=1; while [ $i -le 700 ]; do echo "line $i of the build log: compiled module $i without warnings"; i=$((i+1)); done
i=1; while [ $i -le 700 ]; do echo "line $i of the build log: compiled module $i without warnings"; i=$((i+1)); done; true
